Roofing · AI Assistant

AI assistant for roofing companies

Your roofing leads don't clock out at 5 PM.

Turn new inquiries into organized conversations faster with AI-assisted response, qualification, CRM updates, follow-up and scheduling.

What it does

  • Respond to new inquiries
  • Ask approved qualification questions
  • Capture project information
  • Update CRM records
  • Answer approved common questions
  • Send follow-ups
  • Offer appropriate scheduling options
  • Trigger reminders
  • Escalate conversations to humans

What it doesn't do

  • Roof inspections
  • Professional roofing assessments
  • Final estimates
  • Safety judgments
  • Technical roofing decisions

FAQ

It responds to new inquiries, asks approved qualification questions, captures project information, updates your CRM, answers common questions, offers scheduling options, and escalates to your team when needed.

It does not perform roof inspections, professional assessments, final estimates, or safety judgments — those stay with your team.

Yes. The workflow is designed to hand off to your team for qualified opportunities, complex questions, or anything requiring judgment.

This page covers the assistant's role across a conversation — qualification, information capture, and CRM updates. A dedicated receptionist-style setup focused specifically on inbound call/inquiry handling is a related but separate configuration; ask us which fits your setup.
